description: Dated regulatory developments feeding the briefing's 'what happened' section. Real, verifiable milestones with their published dates and sources. The analyst maintains currency; the live scan and FDA feeds add new entries. Dates are as published; confirm against the linked primary source.

events.headline: FDA revoked the authorization for FD&C Red No. 3 in food
events.what_happened: FDA issued a final rule revoking the color additive authorization for FD&C Red No. 3 in food and ingested drugs in response to a color additive petition, with a food compliance date of January 15, 2027. Beverages using Red No. 3 must reformulate.

events.headline: FDA proposed a front-of-package Nutrition Info box
events.what_happened: FDA published a proposed rule for a mandatory front-of-package nutrition label rating Saturated Fat, Sodium, and Added Sugars as Low, Medium, or High. Comment and finalization follow; added sugar is the key beverage trigger.

events.headline: FDA 'healthy' claim final rule took effect
events.what_happened: The updated definition of the 'healthy' nutrient content claim became effective, with a compliance date of February 25, 2028. Products implying 'healthy' must fit a food-group model.

events.headline: FDA and HHS announced a phase-out of petroleum-based synthetic dyes
events.what_happened: FDA and HHS announced an effort to phase out petroleum-based synthetic food dyes and to authorize new natural color additives, signaling reformulation pressure across colored beverages.

events.headline: FDA revocation of brominated vegetable oil took effect
events.what_happened: FDA's final rule revoking the food authorization for brominated vegetable oil became effective, removing BVO as a permitted food ingredient nationally and aligning with California AB 418.

events.headline: California signed the California Food Safety Act (AB 418)
events.what_happened: California enacted AB 418 banning BVO, potassium bromate, propylparaben, and Red No. 3 in foods sold in California effective January 1, 2027, setting the template other states have followed.
